units.source_text: 你常常说，和龙枝在一起的时候，不会遭到意外的灾难，因此就放心了。

en.t: You often said that when you were with Ryushi, no unexpected disaster would befall you, and so you felt at ease.

units.source_text: 我曾向你说过弟弟快要溺死时的事情，你说了上面的话。

en.t: I once told you about the time my younger brother nearly drowned, and that was when you said those words.
